sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-122B-A10B Heretic — INT4+FP8 hybrid + MTP for DGX Spark (GB10) Build log + recipe for an uncensored Qwen3.5-122B-A10B that runs at ~45 tok/s on a single NVIDIA DGX Spark (GB10, 121 GB unified) via vLLM, using Intel AutoRound INT4 + FP8 hybrid quantization and working MTP speculative decoding.

sources.title: Qwen3.5 Local Inference Benchmark Results: 4 Machines × 5 Engines
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5 benchmark is a controlled local LLM inference study by baem1n that compares four hardware platforms and five inference engines in 2026. The benchmark measures Qwen3.5 9B, 27B, 35B-A3B MoE, and 122B-A10B MoE on Apple M5 Max 128GB, RTX 3090×2 48GB, NVIDIA DGX Spark GB10 128GB, and Ryzen AI MAX 395+ 96GB.
